summary: The at-most-five-support inequality and exact equality classification are correct. Exact regeneration and an independent direct all-support computation verify all 4,368 five-subsets; the result remains explicitly subsidiary and leaves full HC4 unresolved.
limitations: No claim is established for supports of size at least six.
The original universal d=4 Hypercube Inequality remains unresolved.
